sources.entry: AI Models Catalog - Structured YAML catalog of 4,587+ AI models across 95 providers with pricing, context windows, modalities, and capabilities. First-party data with TypeScript types, Zod validation, interactive comparison tool, and 17 SEO pages for model discovery.

summary.one_liner: A repository that describes itself as a structured YAML catalog of AI models with pricing, context windows, modalities, and capabilities, but the README was not available, so this summary relies on the listing text only.
summary.what_it_does: The README could not be retrieved, so details come only from the listing description. According to that description, the repo holds a YAML catalog of roughly 4,587 AI models across 95 providers, with pricing, context windows, modalities, and capabilities for each. The listing also mentions TypeScript types and Zod validation for the data, an interactive comparison tool, and 17 SEO pages for model discovery. Features beyond these are unverified.
use_cases: compare AI model pricing across providers
look up context window sizes for LLMs
find models by modality or capability
browse a catalog of AI models
notable: Structured YAML data for thousands of AI models
Includes TypeScript types and Zod validation
17 SEO pages for model discovery (per listing)
caveats: README was not available, so setup, licensing, and maintenance status could not be verified
Model counts and provider numbers come from the listing text and are unverified
